segments: Behind him, the silhouette of a colossal demon with ten heads and twenty arms emerges from the swirling smoke of a distant fire, his skin burning with an unnatural crimson hue as he roars, causing the very ground beneath the throne to tremble violently
segments_zh: 在他身后，一道十头二十臂的巨大恶魔身影，从远处火焰的烟雾中浮现出来，他的皮肤燃烧着不自然的猩红，他的咆哮让王座下方的地面剧烈颤抖。
